scripts.postinstall: npm --workspace @test-puerts/build-tools run build && npx gulp ue:build --verbose && npx gulp ue:gen_vscode_settings --verbose && npx gulp workspace:clean
scripts.dev: nodemon -w tools/build/src -e ts -x "npm --workspace @test-puerts/build-tools run build && npx gulp dev --verbose"
scripts.check: npm --workspace @test-puerts/build-tools run check && npx gulp check
scripts.clean: npx gulp clean && npm --workspace @test-puerts/build-tools run clean
